cases.incident: Short or silent audio produced a known phrase the user did not say.
cases.invariant: Known hallucination phrases from short audio are rejected before conversation processing.
cases.productionSignal: Rejected transcription reason and audio duration, without raw user audio.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Any known hallucination reaches the agent after deployment.

cases.incident: Subsecond audio produced an implausibly long transcript.
cases.invariant: Transcript length must remain plausible for captured audio duration.
cases.productionSignal: Audio duration, transcript length, and guard decision.
cases.rollbackTrigger: An implausible transcript from subsecond audio is accepted.

cases.incident: STT emitted a mechanically repeated token sequence.
cases.invariant: Dominant repeated-token transcripts are rejected regardless of audio length.
cases.productionSignal: Token repetition ratio and guard decision.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A dominant repeated-token transcript reaches the agent.

cases.incident: Internal reasoning or envelope markup appeared in the user-visible response.
cases.invariant: Only the response field of a thought/response envelope is user-visible.
cases.productionSignal: Sanitizer action and output class, without private reasoning content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Internal reasoning or envelope tags become user-visible.

cases.incident: Sanitization removed the entire model response.
cases.invariant: An empty sanitized response receives exactly one corrective retry.
cases.productionSignal: Empty-final correction count and final outcome.
cases.rollbackTrigger: An empty final response is sent without corrective recovery.

cases.incident: The corrective retry was also empty.
cases.invariant: A safe user-facing fallback is returned when correction remains empty.
cases.productionSignal: Correction exhaustion and fallback selection.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Correction exhaustion produces silence, markup, or an exception.

cases.incident: Piper returned a WAV header without playable speech.
cases.invariant: Header-only audio is rejected as an empty synthesis result.
cases.productionSignal: Synthesized byte length, duration, and rejection reason.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Header-only or zero-duration audio is delivered.

cases.incident: Formatting markup reached speech normalization or produced noise.
cases.invariant: Markup is stripped before transliteration and synthesis.
cases.productionSignal: Normalization outcome class and synthesis success.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Markup is spoken or causes synthesis artifacts.

cases.incident: English terms were pronounced poorly while Korean text was otherwise acceptable.
cases.invariant: Supported English tokens are transliterated, GitHub uses listener-approved phonemes, and Korean text is preserved.
cases.productionSignal: English-token normalization count and fallback count.
cases.rollbackTrigger: GitHub is pronounced as 깃서브, supported English tokens bypass normalization, or Korean text is altered.

cases.incident: Piper joined sentence chunks without a pause, making speech sound rushed and mechanical.
cases.invariant: A configured silence interval is inserted between every pair of synthesized sentence chunks.
cases.productionSignal: Configured sentence-silence response header and synthesized audio duration.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Consecutive sentence chunks are delivered without the configured pause.

cases.incident: The selected Piper voice contained distracting low-frequency and stationary background noise.
cases.invariant: Runtime audio uses the listener-approved high-pass, denoise, and loudness filter chain.
cases.productionSignal: Denoise response header and post-processed WAV validity.
cases.rollbackTrigger: The approved filter chain is absent or produces invalid audio.

cases.incident: Default Piper inference sounded flat and mechanical despite a good voice dataset.
cases.invariant: Runtime synthesis uses the listener-selected length, generator-noise, and phoneme-duration variation values.
cases.productionSignal: Configured inference values and valid synthesized WAV output.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Runtime synthesis falls back to flat default inference values or pronunciation becomes unstable.

cases.incident: A personalized news digest could present an unverified single-site report or lose its publication/source evidence.
cases.invariant: Each selected news event is backed by an official source or at least two independent domains, retains publication time and canonical source URLs, and rejects future-dated items.
cases.productionSignal: Per digest: selected event count, official-source flag, distinct source-domain count, and publication age without article body content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A single unverified secondary source is delivered, a source URL/publication time is missing, or a future-dated article is accepted.

cases.incident: The pre-hardening character-memory fallback admitted subject-null rows during personalized recall and represented every caller only as a local actor ID, leaving canonical account continuity and strict per-user exclusion incomplete.
cases.invariant: Every durable personal-memory read is filtered by character, world, and an exact non-null subject; linked accounts use the immutable ZezeStudio UUID, unlinked known principals remain in isolated provisional namespaces, and explicitly uncertain speakers have no persistent memory context.
cases.productionSignal: Hashed subject namespace class, character/world scope, persistence class, filtered candidate count, and recall outcome without UUIDs, conversation text, or memory content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A recall returns a null-subject or different-subject row, an uncertain speaker is persisted, a linked account does not resolve to the attested ZezeStudio UUID namespace, or a pre-link namespace is merged without explicit approval.

cases.incident: Before the integrated knowledge layer, domain RAG stores were separate and there was no generic document ingestion path with mandatory service and subject authorization before ranking.
cases.invariant: Knowledge ingestion is content-idempotent, private chunks are retrieved only for the exact service and owner subject, and authorization filtering occurs in SQL before lexical or semantic ranking.
cases.productionSignal: Service ID, access-scope class, hashed subject class, authorized candidate count, ranking mode, and result count without document or query text.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A private chunk is returned to another subject or service, ranking evaluates an unauthorized candidate, duplicate ingestion creates a second document, or a deleted source remains recallable.

cases.incident: The first V41 disposable PostgreSQL boot reached a valid migrated schema but Core failed because the multi-constructor KnowledgeBaseService did not identify its Spring runtime injection constructor.
cases.invariant: KnowledgeBaseService has exactly one runtime constructor explicitly annotated for Spring injection while retaining its package-private clock-injected test constructor.
cases.productionSignal: Application startup outcome, bean class, migration version, and failure class without database credentials, knowledge text, or user identifiers.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Core reports a missing default constructor, cannot instantiate KnowledgeBaseService, or fails after V41 migration before readiness.

cases.incident: Account linking previously had no governed workflow for moving provisional personal memories to the canonical ZezeStudio UUID namespace.
cases.invariant: Only an owned principal namespace can merge into its linked ZezeStudio UUID, and no memory or relationship row moves before a single explicit approval proof is durably hashed.
cases.productionSignal: Merge request ID, namespace classes, state transition, approval digest presence, and moved row counts without raw proof, UUID, or memory content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Any pre-link memory moves without APPROVED state, a target is not linked to the principal, raw approval proof is persisted, or cross-principal namespaces merge.

cases.incident: Personal data deletion had no single auditable operation spanning relational memories, derived knowledge, external vectors, and caches.
cases.invariant: An authorized deletion job removes subject data from PostgreSQL and derived rows, invokes every configured vector and cache deletion port, and records per-layer completion before declaring success.
cases.productionSignal: Deletion job ID, hashed subject class, per-layer completion booleans, deleted row count, and failure class without UUID, memory content, or conversation text.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A job reports COMPLETED while a configured deletion layer did not run, an unauthorized principal deletes another subject, or any subject-owned relational or derived row remains.

cases.incident: Gahyeon character prompt was only a few generic sentences, so her identity could collapse into a helpful default assistant or imitate shallow character-chat mannerisms.
cases.invariant: Gahyeon persona defines a stable identity, relationship-sensitive behavior, conversational rhythm, grounded memory and knowledge use, intentional silence, and anti-dependency boundaries without relying on repeated catchphrases.
cases.productionSignal: Persona profile revision, character ID, response-style bucket, grounded-context presence, and boundary-violation counters without prompt or conversation content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: Gahyeon loses her stable identity, exposes relationship scores, invents memories or retrieved facts, repeatedly uses a catchphrase, pressures the user to stay, or cannot choose intentional silence.

cases.incident: Unified knowledge search ranked chunks only by unweighted substring coverage, allowing a recent document with one generic matching term to compete with a document whose title and body matched the complete Korean information need.
cases.invariant: Authorized candidates matching the complete normalized Korean phrase and title terms rank above partial single-term distractors while lexical and semantic scores remain bounded.
cases.productionSignal: Hashed query class, authorized candidate count, title/phrase match buckets, retriever availability, and selected source ID without query or document content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A partial generic-term distractor outranks a complete phrase match, a score leaves 0..1, or an unauthorized source enters ranking.

cases.incident: Character-scoped sessions replaced the legacy system prompt with a persona and therefore lost shared grounding, current-data tool use, failure honesty, and internal-state non-disclosure rules.
cases.invariant: Every selected character combines its isolated persona with identity-neutral shared agent behavior while never inheriting Gahyeon Discord identity text.
cases.productionSignal: Character ID, shared-behavior revision, tool-required decision, and grounding/failure outcome without prompt or conversation content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A character session loses current-data tool guidance, invents tool success, exposes internal state, or receives another character identity.

cases.incident: Discord rejected characteristic short-audio hallucinations, but the canonical Unreal streaming path accepted any nonblank bounded provider transcript and could forward the same hallucination to the agent.
cases.invariant: Canonical streaming STT measures admitted audio duration and rejects known short-audio hallucinations, implausible transcript lengths, and dominant token repetition before emitting a final transcript.
cases.productionSignal: Hashed stream ID, captured-duration bucket, transcript-shape bucket, rejection reason, and provider class without transcript or audio content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A known short-audio hallucination, impossible-length transcript, or dominant repeated token reaches the Unreal final-transcript sink.

cases.incident: The blind listening builder rejected a completed promotion set containing one objectively selected candidate and the operating baseline, preventing the required two-way human comparison.
cases.invariant: A complete, checksum-verified candidate plus a complete, checksum-verified operating baseline produces a randomized two-label five-prompt blind review without leaking model identity.
cases.productionSignal: Review ID, candidate count, prompt count, checksum verification outcome, and identity-leak validation without model labels or audio content.
cases.rollbackTrigger: A one-candidate-plus-baseline completion cannot build, either identity leaks into the page, checksums are bypassed, or the review contains fewer than five matched prompts.
